description: Klee transcribes your meetings and makes them available to ChatGPT. Search and query your transcripts ("where did we discuss the budget?"), retrieve documents, check your remaining hours, organize projects with their vocabulary and participants, prepare sessions and schedule Teams meetings. Sensitive actions always ask for your confirmation. Requires a Klee account (5-hour free trial at klee-app.com). App and transcripts are French-first - built for French-speaking meetings.

defaultPrompt: Où parle-t-on du budget dans mes réunions ?
